title: Shedlock pause experiment: runner protocol and decision log
purpose: Closes the measurement gap in Scout's pause experiment (artifact 2973e17f). Provides a verbatim runner checklist, a pre-registered decision log that must be filled before data is seen, and a tally sheet formatted to match the existing listener_response_sheet.txt. Any runner can pick up artifact 2973e17f alongside this package, complete a session and report exactly where protocol held or broke.
